    hits=$(grep -rn 'pkgs\.system\b' "$storepath" --include='*.nix' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'pkgs\.systemd' | head -3)
    if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
      echo "=== $input ($storepath) ==="
      echo "$hits"
    fi
  fi
done

# 全-sourceパスでpkgs.systemを検索（systemdを除外）
for p in /nix/store/*-source; do
  [ -d "$p" ] || continue
  hits=$(grep -rl 'pkgs\.system[^d]' "$p/" --include='*.nix' 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
    desc=$(head -1 "$p/flake.nix" 2>/dev/null || echo "no flake")
    echo "=== $p ($desc) ==="
    grep -rn 'pkgs\.system[^d]' "$p/" --include='*.nix' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'hostPlatform\|#.*pkgs\.system\|targetPlatform\|stdenv' | head -5
    echo
  fi
done 2>/dev/null
